_meta.name: Good Time to Find a Quality Job
_meta.unit: percent saying now is a good time to find a quality job
_meta.source: Gallup, Good Time to Find a Quality Job
_meta.note: "Thinking about the job situation in America today, would you say that it is now a good time or a bad time to find a quality job?" Question wording from the chart metadata (gZ2wl/9). Annual mean of published monthly values; multiple polls within a month are averaged before averaging months. Recent polling is roughly quarterly, not monthly; unpublished months are absent, never interpolated. All overlapping readings must agree exactly. The sourceUrl is the pinned Datawrapper CSV because the chart metadata's source-url is empty; pinned versions are retained for reproducibility and may lag the current chart.
_meta.method: Datawrapper 8YPmK/1 + gZ2wl/4, named column % Good time / % Good time; exact overlap checks, mean within month then mean of published months per year
